### `faker` (inline helper)

`faker fakerType: string`

Generate fake data via reflection over *gofakeit.Faker (v6.28.0). Only zero-arg method names are valid. https://docs.hoverfly.io/en/latest/pages/keyconcepts/templating/templating.html

**Kind:** inline helper · **Arity:** 1 argument(s) · **Source:** Hoverfly helper

Example: `{{faker 'Name'}}`
